# EKOTAI BOL (একতাই বল)
> একতাই শক্তি, উদ্যোগে পরিবর্তন।

EKOTAI BOL (https://ekoitaibol.com) is Bangladesh's first nationwide public-benefit civic innovation, community voting, and transparent micro-crowdfunding platform covering all 64 districts.

## Core Pillars
- **Public Idea Submission**: Free submission for citizens. Raw proposals refined by AI Co-pilot into actionable project plans.
- **64 District Boards**: Community voting and 5-star ratings with constructive positive/negative critiques.
- **100 Taka Micro-Crowdfunding**: 100% transparent live ledger tracking voluntary backing with masked phone numbers (e.g. 0171****890).
- **Sustainable Local Employment & Welfare**: Ground-level implementation with statutory labor rights and Universal Pension Scheme (সর্বজনীন পেনশন) coverage.
